result:
Plan created successfully.

**Plan file created at:** `specs/chore-183a2d66-fix-onboarding-style-ui.md`

The plan addresses all the UI issues identified:

1. **Remove duplicate score bars** - Removes both `OnboardingProgress` (step dots) and `CarouselDots` (carousel position indicators)
2. **Fix card borders** - Changes from harsh crimson (#C41E3A) to soft rose/pink (#E8D5D5) borders
3. **Improve text visibility** - Updates description text color from gray-500 to gray-700 for better contrast on cream background
4. **Style card layout** - Cards will show large image, bold "Style · Adjective" title, and full description text with soft rounded borders

Key files to modify:
- `frontend/components/onboarding/OnboardingStyle.tsx` - Main component changes
- `frontend/app/globals.css` - Add soft rose color variables
